pages.title: Harbour Studies
pages.description: Drawings made around the harbour become instructions for a pen plotter. Each work develops a different set of routes, with line density adjusted through repeated paper proofs.

blocks.content: 2025–26 / Generative drawing
Drawings made around the harbour become instructions for a pen plotter. Each work develops a different set of routes, with line density adjusted through repeated paper proofs.

The project began with repeated walks along the coast at Margate. Notebook drawings were translated into plotting instructions, then revised against physical proofs. Pen speed, spacing and ink density are tested on paper throughout.
Selected drawings will be shown at Rook Passage Gallery, Margate, from 18 September to 24 October 2026.

pages.title: Colour Register
pages.description: Screenprint separations are deliberately shifted between passes. Compositions are revised on paper, where each overlap produces a colour that cannot be assessed from the digital file alone.

blocks.content: 2024–25 / Screenprint
Screenprint separations are deliberately shifted between passes. Compositions are revised on paper, where each overlap produces a colour that cannot be assessed from the digital file alone.

The series developed through repeated press sessions with a small set of screens. An initial arrangement is printed in several sequences before its separations are revised. Working proofs remain beside the press throughout each edition.
Works from the series were included in Systems in Print at Alder Yard Project Space, London, in 2025.

pages.title: Night Windows
pages.description: Window arrangements recorded on evening walks are rebuilt as modular compositions. Each illuminated work is tested at daylight and evening brightness before fabrication.

blocks.content: 2023–25 / Light works
Window arrangements recorded on evening walks are rebuilt as modular compositions. Each illuminated work is tested at daylight and evening brightness before fabrication.

The compositions begin as notebook records of windows, landings and stairwells. I translate them into arrangements of translucent screens and illuminated openings, testing the spacing and light levels in a scale model before installation.
The first presentation of the series took place at East Cut Rooms, Ramsgate, in 2024.

pages.title: Studio
pages.description: An independent practice in drawing, print and light, based between London and Margate.

blocks.content: Practice & background
An independent practice in drawing, print and light, based between London and Margate.

blocks.title: Ada Mercer’s studio, with drawing and print work in progress
blocks.caption: The Margate studio, 2026.

blocks.content: Born 1988

I began developing drawing systems in 2016 and established my independent print studio in 2019. My projects combine self-written software with physical tests of ink, paper and light, working between London and Margate.

Harbour Studies draws on repeated walks along the coast; Colour Register developed through experiments with misaligned screenprints; Night Windows reconstructs patterns observed after dark. I work with specialist printers and fabricators on small editions and site-specific commissions.
